preconditions.description: The number of tiles in the bag is between 1 and 200,000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i in {1, 2} for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each tile has a number written on it, either 1 or 2.

postconditions.description: The output permutation has the same number of elements as the input sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(b_i in {1, 2} for b_i in b)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output permutation is either 1 or 2.
The output permutation maximizes the number of prime prefix sums.
